exposure: Continuous analgesia with fentanyl and palonosetron (control)
Continuous analgesia with 1.0 ug/kg dexmedetomidine, butorphanol, fentanyl, and palonosetron (low-dose dexmedetomidine)
Continuous analgesia with 2.0 ug/kg dexmedetomidine, butorphanol, fentanyl, and palonosetron (high-dose dexmedetomidine)
cohort: 60 puerperae undergoing a cesarean section from a single center.
finding: Dexmedetomidine combined with butorphanol significantly improved analgesic and sedative effects after a cesarean section, with higher doses of dexmedetomidine yielding better results.
